preconditions.description: Board dimensions n, m and number of chips k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sx <= n and 1 <= sy <= m for sx, sy in start_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting positions (sx_i, sy_i) are valid coordinates within the n x m board.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fx <= n and 1 <= fy <= m for fx, fy in target_positions)
preconditions.description: All target positions (fx_i, fy_i) are valid coordinates within the n x m board.
The number of starting and target positions matches the number of chips k.

postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists within 2nm moves, the output is a single line containing -1.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == 2 and output_lines[0].isdigit() and len(output_lines[1]) == int(output_lines[0])
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the first line is the count of operations (an integer) and the second line is the sequence of operations with length matching that count.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'LRDU' for c in output_lines[1]) if len(output_lines) == 2 else True
postconditions.description: The sequence of operations consists only of valid characters L, R, D, U.

postconditions.expression: int(output_lines[0]) <= 2 * n * m if len(output_lines) == 2 else True
postconditions.description: The number of operations does not exceed the limit of 2nm.

postconditions.expression: all(any(chip_pos == target for chip_pos in simulate_path(start, ops)) for start, target in zip(start_positions, target_positions)) if len(output_lines) == 2 else True
postconditions.description: For every chip, the sequence of operations causes it to visit its assigned target position at least once during the simulation, respecting wall constraints.
